home.hero_subtitle: Build a Codex-style coding-agent harness from 0 to 1, one mechanism at a time
home.core_pattern_desc: Every coding agent shares the same loop: call the model on the Responses API, execute the function calls it returns, and feed each output back. Production harnesses like Codex add approval, sandboxing, and lifecycle layers on top.
home.learning_path_desc: 20 progressive sessions, from a single loop to a complete multi-agent harness
home.layers_desc: Five orthogonal concerns that compose into a complete agent harness
home.message_flow_desc: Watch the input items grow as the agent loop drives the Responses API

layers.title: Architectural Layers
layers.subtitle: Five orthogonal concerns that compose into a complete agent harness
layers.tools: What the agent CAN do. The foundation: function tools give the model capabilities to act on the world, gated by approval and sandbox policy.
layers.planning: How work is organized. From the update_plan checklist to instructions assembled from AGENTS.md and config.toml.
layers.memory: Keeping context within limits. Auto-compaction and session rollouts let agents work indefinitely without losing coherence.
layers.concurrency: Non-blocking execution. Background tasks and scheduled automations for parallel and recurring work.
layers.collaboration: Multi-agent coordination. Task boards, teams, protocols, worktrees, and MCP servers that let agents work together.
